lines.en: I trot along on quick small paws.
I am not alone in these woods.
Two more follow behind me.

lines.zh: 我回头看了一眼，继续走
lines.en: I glance back once and keep going.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵一动一动，听两边
lines.en: My ears flick, listening both ways.
I follow the game trail without turning.
My tail hangs low.

lines.zh: 干燥的土在我脚下起尘
lines.en: Dry soil puffs under my feet.

lines.zh: 我经过一堆骨头，没有停
lines.en: I pass a heap of bones and do not stop.
I sniff along the brush line.
The three of us move in a line.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，怕惊到东西
lines.en: I step lightly so nothing startles.

lines.zh: 我在一块干地上打了个转
lines.en: I turn a circle on dry ground.
I sniff the roots ahead.
I hop a shallow ditch.
I swap places with a packmate.
I stop and go, waiting for the rest.

lines.zh: 我的爪印一路留在土上
lines.en: My prints stay in the dirt behind me.

lines.zh: 我坐下来，一只耳朵歪着
lines.en: I sit with one ear cocked.

lines.zh: 另外两只在我旁边趴着
lines.en: The other two lie beside me.
My tongue shows a little.

lines.zh: 我小跑着，后面的两只跟着。
lines.en: I trot, two more behind me.
The smell of carrion rides the wind.
I run in packs through forest and dry land.

lines.zh: 一只鸟落在低枝上，我看它
lines.en: A bird lands low; I watch it.
I rest my head on my forepaws.
Wind sweeps leaves to my feet.
I pant, tongue very red.
One packmate rolls over.
I glance up at the tree shadows.
Insects are calling in the woods.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上刨了两下
lines.en: I paw the ground twice.
We take turns lifting our heads.
A small bug is on my fur.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，两只耳朵都朝你
lines.en: I raise my head, both ears toward you.

lines.zh: 后面那两只也站起来了
lines.en: The two behind me stand up too.
The three of us watch you together.
You are not from this wood.

lines.zh: 我歪头，判断你有没有威胁
lines.en: I tilt my head, judging your threat.

lines.zh: 我一个人不敢，可我们不只一个
lines.en: Alone I would not dare; we are not one.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴轻轻摇了一下
lines.en: My tail wags once.
If you retreat, we advance.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里有低低的声音
lines.en: A low sound sits in my throat.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧面，同伴在后。
lines.en: I slide to your flank; my pack is behind me.

lines.zh: 我抬起一条前腿，又放下
lines.en: I lift a foreleg, then set it down.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我看清了
lines.en: I have seen clearly what you hold.
I yelp and leap aside.
I tuck one leg up.
The two behind give half a step.
I tuck my tail away.
My ears flatten right back.
I lower my head and bare my teeth.
I yelp sharply and back into the grass.
I curl to guard my belly.
My hind leg trembles.
I press toward my packmates.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道也行，我不挑
lines.en: Carrion will do; I am not fussy.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，够谁吃
lines.en: That little thing—who could it feed?
I lower my head and approach slowly.
The two behind are sniffing too.
I will not snatch; first I see if you offer.
Better than yesterday's heap.

lines.zh: 你退开一步，我就敢上前
lines.en: Step back and I will dare come close.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张着，口水都出来了
lines.en: My mouth is open and drooling.
I crouch and do not lunge.
The two behind me swallow hard.
We all tilt our heads one way.

lines.zh: 你要是扔出来，我们得抢
lines.en: If you throw it, we will fight over it.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔鼻子，群里的味道到了。
lines.en: I lick my nose; the pack's scent is here.
I edge half a step toward you.

lines.zh: 这味道让我们都静了下来
lines.en: The smell quiets all of us.
I do not yelp; yelping loses the meal.
You step on me and I spring away.
One behind collides with your leg.

lines.zh: 我们三个把你围在中间
lines.en: The three of us box you in.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，从你腿间钻过
lines.en: I slip sideways between your legs.

lines.zh: 你踢了一下，我躲开半步
lines.en: You kick; I dodge half a step.
My paw lands on your shoe.
Your elbow meets my head.
We collide and I roll.

lines.zh: 一只同伴从你另一边挤过来
lines.en: A packmate squeezes in on your other side.
I turn a full circle against you.

lines.zh: 你的脚把我挤到灌木边
lines.en: Your foot presses me to the brush.
We burst a pile of dry leaves apart.

lines.zh: 她走过来，鼻子碰我的鼻子
lines.en: She comes over and touches noses with me.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此转了一圈
lines.en: We circle each other once.

lines.zh: 后面那两只退开了一些
lines.en: The two behind give us room.
She licks my ear once.

lines.zh: 我们并肩坐着，看同一个方向
lines.en: We sit side by side, facing one way.

lines.zh: 这一群里有她，我心里稳
lines.en: With her in the pack, I feel steady.

lines.zh: 她替我把背上的土舔掉
lines.en: She licks the dirt from my back.

lines.zh: 我们一起抬头叫了一声
lines.en: Together we lift our heads and call.

lines.zh: 她把鼻子埋进我的颈毛
lines.en: She buries her nose in my neck fur.
It is cold; we press closer.
I lower my head and take a bone.
I carry it off to one side.

lines.zh: 我用前爪按住，啃了一下
lines.en: I pin it with a paw and gnaw once.
Another approaches; I bare my teeth.
I bury it under a tree.
I look back once after burying it.
One dip of my head and I have it.
I trot two steps with it.
The other two stare at my mouth.
I hold it under a paw and refuse.
All three of us lift our heads at once.

lines.zh: 后面那两只已经散开了
lines.en: The two behind have already spread out.
I crouch and edge forward.

lines.zh: 你只有一个，我们有三个
lines.en: You are one; we are three.
I move first; they will follow.

lines.zh: 这一群比单独一只厉害
lines.en: A pack is stronger than one.
I crouch, tail straight out.

lines.zh: 我跟同伴对了一个眼神
lines.en: I trade a glance with a packmate.
We begin to split and circle.
You have not moved; we wait.

lines.zh: 我从左边绕，它们在右边
lines.en: I take the left; they take the right.
Wherever you run, you stay in the ring.

lines.zh: 我们轮流上前，不一起冲
lines.en: We take turns advancing, not all at once.
You turn and we give half a step.
I follow your shadow.
I circle to your left.
I watch you while I run.
A packmate halts opposite me.
We have you between us.
I chew a stem and walk slowly.

lines.zh: 一群的时候，我们才敢扑大的。
lines.en: Only as a pack do we take on big prey.
I strike your knee from the side.

lines.zh: 另外两只从后面扑上来
lines.en: The other two lunge from behind.

lines.zh: 我一击就退开，换它们上
lines.en: I strike and pull back to let them in.

lines.zh: 我的牙很小，可我们不只一张嘴
lines.en: My teeth are small, but we have more than one mouth.

lines.zh: 我扑上去咬了一口就退
lines.en: I lunge, bite once, and pull back.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你腿上划过去
lines.en: My claws rake across your leg.
A packmate charges past me.
I twist my head and my teeth clack.
You swing; I drop low.
I slip out from behind the dry grass.
Two more follow me out.
The three of us line up.
Dust shaken off, then I give chase.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子先动，闻这片地
lines.en: My nose works this ground first.

lines.zh: 林子边上多了一群影子
lines.en: A pack of shadows gathers at the wood's edge.

lines.zh: 我从干草丛里出来，身上带刺
lines.en: I come out of the dry grass, full of burrs.

lines.zh: 我先叫了一声，林子回音
lines.en: I call once and the woods answer.

lines.zh: 两只同伴从两边靠过来
lines.en: Two packmates close in from the sides.
I stop on the game trail.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的尾巴，我跑得很快
lines.en: Fire singes my tail and I run fast.

lines.zh: 我们一群追一只鹿，很有把握。
lines.en: A pack of us after one deer, easy.
Water reaches my neck and I paddle hard.
The blast throws me into the brush.
An arrow pierces my haunch.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我全身僵了一下
lines.en: That force stiffens me all over.

lines.zh: 饿得我看见什么都想咬
lines.en: This hungry, I want to bite everything.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我趴了下去
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and I flatten out.

lines.zh: 底下的地没了，我还在跑
lines.en: The ground is gone and I am still running.
